title: Application message identifier
description: The sender-chosen idempotency key for one logical message: exactly 128 bits, as 32 lowercase hex characters at this JSON boundary. It participates in the deduplication key (ADR-0019) and is deliberately NOT the GossipSub mesh duplicate key — that is the authenticated publisher plus wire sequence number (ADR-0004). A retry of the same logical message reuses this value. The wire carries the raw 16 bytes; this is its printable form.
